statement: Reposition or reshape the current selection in interactive transforms with "Scale B-Bone"; the resulting positions or shapes match Blender 5.3 for the same input, only the selected items change, and one undo step restores them.

Create new content in interactive transforms with "Create Orientation"; the new item exists in the document afterwards with the values Blender 5.3 gives it, is the active or selected item where Blender makes it so, and one undo step removes it.

Remove or clear content in interactive transforms with "Delete Orientation"; the targeted data is gone afterwards, unrelated data is untouched, references to it are left valid, and one undo step restores it.
